projects.name: DNR Arista
projects.location: Bellandur Main Road · Marathahalli–Sarjapur Outer Ring Road
projects.category: Connected living in Bellandur
projects.priceNote: Phase 2 · 3 BHK sheet total · April 2026 · exclusions apply
projects.details:
The supplied brochure describes DNR Arista at Bellandur Main Road, Marathahalli–Sarjapur Outer Ring Road: 4.5 acres, 417 flats across 8 blocks, 2B + S + 13 floors, and 30,000 sq ft of clubhouse and amenities. Its project profile lists 2 BHK at 1,260 sq ft, 3 BHK at 1,665–1,685 sq ft, and 4 BHK at 2,025 and 2,385 sq ft. Selected terrace layouts have different super built-up areas; refer to the brochure for the specific unit.

Phase 2 pricing, as on April 2026: 3 BHK + 3 toilets, 1,685 sq ft, unit value ₹2,66,86,000; including 5% unit GST ₹2,80,20,300; approximate additional charges ₹10,23,780; sheet total ₹2,90,44,080. The H1/H2/G1/G2 3 BHK option, also 1,685 sq ft, has unit value ₹2,70,23,000; including 5% unit GST ₹2,83,74,150; approximate additional charges ₹10,23,780; sheet total ₹2,93,97,930. Both list 1,140.50 sq ft RERA carpet area, 110.60 sq ft balcony area and one car-parking right.

The 4 BHK + 4 toilets option, 2,025 sq ft, has unit value ₹3,34,02,500; including 5% unit GST ₹3,50,72,625; approximate additional charges ₹11,55,700; published sheet total ₹3,62,28,326. It lists 1,398.99 sq ft RERA carpet area, 110.60 sq ft balcony area and two car-parking rights. The payment-total row rounds the GST-inclusive amount to ₹3,50,72,626, producing a ₹1 difference; confirm the final cost sheet. No prices are supplied for 2 BHK or the 2,385 sq ft 4 BHK.

Approximate additional charges comprise BESCOM/BWSSB and generator charges at ₹300 per sq ft, ₹30,000 legal fee, ₹40,000 Khatha and assessment liaison charges excluding BBMP fees, one year’s advance maintenance at ₹48 per sq ft, sinking fund at ₹40 per sq ft, and ₹3 lakh clubhouse membership. Applicable GST on additional charges except the sinking fund, registration, stamp duty and other statutory charges are extra as specified in the sheet; the listed totals are not final all-inclusive quotations. The sheet specifies 0.5% of sale value as sale-agreement stamp duty and notes that charges may be revised.

Booking amounts are ₹7 lakh for 3 BHK and ₹10 lakh for 4 BHK. The sheet shows a 10% payment stage within 10 days of booking after the booking amount, 80% due as on the sheet date, and 10% on possession; demands depend on the relevant wing/block milestones. It lists floor-rise charges for each two floors of ₹84,250 for 3 BHK and ₹1,01,250 for 4 BHK. Confirm the current payment schedule, floor adjustments, availability and possession date with the developer. No possession date is established by these documents.
